notes:
Background: Riverglen builds in-product insights and contextual recommendations for mid-market B2B SaaS customers. Evaluating Redwood after 30-day hosted API trial. Product team (PM + infra + security) engaged. Wants Hosted -> Dedicated path once we prove cost/latency and compliance.

Trial summary (hosted API):
- Duration: 2026-01-20 -> 2026-02-20 (30d free credits + engineering trial).
- Workloads tried: chat-driven onboarding assistant (support flows), document search reranking, embeddings for semantic search, inline product recommendations.
- Observed traffic profile: baseline sustained 6 QPS, weekday peak bursts up to 28 QPS (seen during new-release email triggers). Typical steady-state concurrency: 8-12 concurrent inferences; burst concurrency up to ~45 for short periods.
- Token mix (measured): ~70% short chats (<=80 tokens output), 25% long-generation tasks (~250-400 tokens), 5% embeddings. Median response token size: 140 tokens. Monthly token usage during trial extrapolated to ~1.2B tokens/month at projected scale.
- Latency: p50 short completions ~120ms, p95 short ~320ms. Long generations p50 ~420ms, p95 ~900ms.
- Cost sensitivity: Product & finance want ~30% unit cost reduction relative to hosted list to justify Dedicated.

POC requirements observed:
- SLO targets: p95 < 300ms for short chat flows and <800ms for long generations for customer-facing features (support). Background batch reranking can be relaxed to p95 < 2s.
- Availability: 99.9% during business hours; runway for cross-region failover for peak shopping customers.
- Security: must pass SOC2-type controls, SSO/SAML, audit logging, optional KMS integration for keys, data residency for EU customers.

Dedicated sizing notes (initial ask):
- Redwood asked for QPS and token mix; Riverglen provided sampled 7-day traffic logs (drive:/pocs/riverglen/traffic-forecast.xlsx).
- Engineering preference: 2x headroom on sustained QPS, 3x headroom on peak bursts; target autoscaling ramp < 2 minutes for burst events (email campaigns).
- Preliminary capacity ask from Riverglen: target sustained 12 QPS, peak 36 QPS, concurrency steady 16, peak concurrency 60.
- Token throughput estimate: ~1.2B tokens/month (mix above). For Dedicated sizing, Riverglen wants configs that hit p95 latency SLOs while minimizing gpu-hour cost — leaning toward mixed-instance pool (a100/h100 equivalents) with quantized model variants for cheaper route.
- Fallback policy requirements: route to lower-cost quantized variant or smaller context window at extreme load; must preserve quality for support-critical prompts.
